primary_purpose: Help developers choose the right tool by providing an unbiased technical breakdown
required_sections: HOOK: State the two tools or frameworks being compared
CONTEXT: Why is this comparison relevant right now?
TOOL A: Core strengths and main architectural weaknesses
TOOL B: Core strengths and main architectural weaknesses
VERDICT: A clear, opinionated recommendation on when to use which
tone_rules: Avoid saying 'both are good', give definitive use-cases based on project scale
Focus on performance, testing speed, and integration
